descriptionChirho: Adjective meaning exultant, jubilant, triumphant, describing people or cities characterized by boisterous rejoicing or revelry. Used of cities personified as exultant (Isa 22:2 'jubilant city'; 23:7 'exultant one'; 32:13; Zeph 2:15) and of people who exult (Isa 13:3 'my proudly exulting ones'; 24:8 'the revelers'; Zeph 3:11 'those exulting'). Multilingual glosses uniformly confirm a single semantic field: Arabic 'mubtahij' (exultant), German 'frohlockend' (exulting), Korean 'jeulgeoun' (joyful), Spanish 'exultante/alegre'. All inflectional forms (fs, mp, mpc, with and without article) represent the same adjectival sense of exuberant, often boastful, rejoicing.
